label: No infinite per se efficient-cause series, via PER_SE_5 actual causes of being
meaning: Non-transcription conditional derivation on one q.3 a.4 profile p, one PER_SE_5 link AsCaused and one secunda via per se link CausesAsCaused. If there is no infinite chain of per se actual causes of being (ea251340, the weakest regress version that suffices) and every per se ordered efficient-cause link is a per se actual cause of being (the new OPEN bridge), then no per se ordered series of efficient causes goes on to infinity (97f5850f). With esseRegressOfActualGroundingWF and the existing strength order 80f81d44 (fd12ad3d to ea251340) it carries well-founded actual grounding to the secunda via's regress premise through esse causing, an alternative to the priority chain e229bb2c. It names the exact missing inclusion: the secunda via joins the one dependence order only if its per se links are per se causes of being. On a respect-free reading of CausesAsCaused the bridge meets ad 7's own per se example (hand, stick, stone: causes of motion, not of being), the same mechanism as the kept counterexample to e078f07b (causal-dependence-support-investigation.md, section (e), row 1); the bridge is defensible only on the existential reading of the second way. The closed controls secundaControls give, for each input, a Bool interpretation in which the other holds and the per se series has a two-cycle, and a nonvacuous interpretation.
